items.question: Trong câu "Two words that sound alike and get mixed up in every project:", từ "alike" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two words that sound alike and get mixed up in every project:", what does "alike" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: alike /əˈlaɪk/ (tính từ): giống nhau. "Sound alike" = nghe giống nhau; thường đứng sau động từ, không đứng trước danh từ.
items.explanationEn: alike /əˈlaɪk/ (adjective): similar to each other. "Sound alike" means sound similar; it usually follows a verb, not a noun.

items.question: Trong câu "The app does not even admit the row exists.", từ "admit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The app does not even admit the row exists.", what does "admit" (verb) mean?
options: cho vào, tiếp nhận (bệnh viện, trường)
items.explanation: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (động từ): thừa nhận. "Admit (that) something exists" = thừa nhận; nghĩa khác: cho vào (admit a patient).
items.explanationEn: admit /ədˈmɪt/ (verb): to confess something is true. "Admit (that) something exists" means confess it; another sense is to let in (admit a patient).

items.question: Trong câu "Write authN and authZ as separate requirements.", từ "requirement" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Write authN and authZ as separate requirements.", what does "requirement" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪə.mənt/ (danh từ): yêu cầu (phần mềm). Cụm hay gặp: functional requirement, non-functional requirement, gather requirements.
items.explanationEn: requirement /rɪˈkwaɪə.mənt/ (noun): something a system must do. Common: functional requirement, non-functional requirement, gather requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "HTTP is stateless: each request arrives on its own, and the server does not remember the previous one.", từ "stateless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "HTTP is stateless: each request arrives on its own, and the server does not remember the previous one.", what does "stateless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stateless /ˈsteɪt.ləs/ (tính từ): không lưu trạng thái. Trái nghĩa: stateful. Nghĩa khác: stateless person = người không quốc tịch.
items.explanationEn: stateless /ˈsteɪt.ləs/ (adjective): keeping no memory between requests. Opposite: stateful. Another sense: a stateless person has no nationality.

items.question: Trong câu "After you log in, the next request (`GET /api/todos`) must somehow prove again who you are.", từ "prove" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "After you log in, the next request (`GET /api/todos`) must somehow prove again who you are.", what does "prove" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prove /pruːv/ (động từ): chứng minh. "Prove who you are" = chứng minh danh tính; danh từ: proof (proof of identity).
items.explanationEn: prove /pruːv/ (verb): to show something is true. "Prove who you are" means show your identity; noun: proof (proof of identity).

items.question: Trong câu "A random, meaningless ID", từ "meaningless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A random, meaningless ID", what does "meaningless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: meaningless /ˈmiː.nɪŋ.ləs/ (tính từ): không mang ý nghĩa. Session ID là chuỗi ngẫu nhiên không chứa thông tin gì; ý nghĩa chỉ nằm ở bảng session trên server.
items.explanationEn: meaningless /ˈmiː.nɪŋ.ləs/ (adjective): having no meaning. A session ID is a random string carrying no data; its meaning lives only in the server's session table.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser attaches the cookie to every request automatically, and the server verifies it with `JWT_SECRET` from `.env`.", từ "attach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser attaches the cookie to every request automatically, and the server verifies it with `JWT_SECRET` from `.env`.", what does "attach" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to add or fasten to something
items.explanation: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (động từ): đính kèm. "Attach X to Y" = đính kèm X vào Y (attach a file to an email); nghĩa khác: be attached to = gắn bó.
items.explanationEn: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (verb): to add or fasten to something. "Attach X to Y" means add X to Y (attach a file to an email); "be attached to" also means feel affection for.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser attaches the cookie to every request automatically, and the server verifies it with `JWT_SECRET` from `.env`.", từ "verify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser attaches the cookie to every request automatically, and the server verifies it with `JWT_SECRET` from `.env`.", what does "verify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to check that something is true or valid
items.explanation: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): xác minh, kiểm tra. Hay gặp: verify a token, verify an email; danh từ: verification.
items.explanationEn: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to check that something is true or valid. Common: verify a token, verify an email; noun: verification.

items.question: Trong câu ""Log out of all devices" or "an admin can kick a user out right now" is easy with server-side sessions and costly with pure JWTs.", từ "costly" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Log out of all devices" or "an admin can kick a user out right now" is easy with server-side sessions and costly with pure JWTs.", what does "costly" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: costly /ˈkɒst.li/ (tính từ): tốn kém. "Costly" = tốn kém (tiền hoặc công sức); costly mistake = sai lầm đắt giá.
items.explanationEn: costly /ˈkɒst.li/ (adjective): expensive in money or effort. "Costly" means expensive in money or effort; a costly mistake is one with a high price.

items.question: Trong câu ""Log out of all devices" or "an admin can kick a user out right now" is easy with server-side sessions and costly with pure JWTs.", từ "kick out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Log out of all devices" or "an admin can kick a user out right now" is easy with server-side sessions and costly with pure JWTs.", what does "kick out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: kick out /kɪk aʊt/ (cụm từ): đuổi ra, buộc thoát. "Kick someone out" = buộc ai đó rời đi; trong IT: buộc đăng xuất một user.
items.explanationEn: kick out /kɪk aʊt/ (phrase): to force someone to leave. "Kick someone out" means force them to leave; in IT, force a user to log out.

items.question: Trong câu "Hard: the token stays valid until it expires", từ "expire" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hard: the token stays valid until it expires", what does "expire" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stop being valid after a time
items.explanation: expire /ɪkˈspaɪə/ (động từ): hết hạn. Hay gặp: the token expires, an expired session; danh từ: expiry, expiration. Nghĩa trang trọng khác: qua đời.
items.explanationEn: expire /ɪkˈspaɪə/ (verb): to stop being valid after a time. Common: the token expires, an expired session; noun: expiry, expiration. A formal second sense: to die.

items.question: Trong câu "Delete the row: instantly dead everywhere", từ "instantly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Delete the row: instantly dead everywhere", what does "instantly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (trạng từ): ngay lập tức. "Instantly" = ngay lập tức; tính từ: instant (instant feedback).
items.explanationEn: instantly /ˈɪn.stənt.li/ (adverb): immediately. "Instantly" means immediately; adjective: instant (instant feedback).

items.question: Trong câu "Notice the 201 took 86 ms and the 409 took 0 ms: the slow part is the bcrypt hash, which the duplicate case never reaches.", từ "duplicate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Notice the 201 took 86 ms and the 409 took 0 ms: the slow part is the bcrypt hash, which the duplicate case never reaches.", what does "duplicate" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: being an exact copy of another
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (tính từ): trùng lặp. "Duplicate email/record" = email/bản ghi trùng; cũng là danh từ "a duplicate" và động từ /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuː.plɪ.kət/ (adjective): being an exact copy of another. "A duplicate email/record" is one that already exists; also a noun ("a duplicate") and a verb /ˈdjuː.plɪ.keɪt/.

items.question: Trong câu "Databases leak, and people reuse passwords, so one leak of plain passwords opens their email and bank accounts too.", từ "leak" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Databases leak, and people reuse passwords, so one leak of plain passwords opens their email and bank accounts too.", what does "leak" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: leak /liːk/ (động từ): bị rò rỉ (dữ liệu). Data leak = rò rỉ dữ liệu; nghĩa gốc: rỉ nước (the roof leaks).
items.explanationEn: leak /liːk/ (verb): to escape and become known. A data leak is data escaping; the original sense is liquid escaping (the roof leaks).

items.question: Trong câu "Databases leak, and people reuse passwords, so one leak of plain passwords opens their email and bank accounts too.", từ "reuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Databases leak, and people reuse passwords, so one leak of plain passwords opens their email and bank accounts too.", what does "reuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (động từ): dùng lại. "Password reuse" = dùng lại một mật khẩu cho nhiều tài khoản, lý do chính khiến rò rỉ lan rộng.
items.explanationEn: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (verb): to use again. "Password reuse" means one password for many accounts, the main reason leaks spread.

items.question: Trong câu "Two-way: whoever holds the key can decrypt", từ "decrypt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two-way: whoever holds the key can decrypt", what does "decrypt" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn encrypted data back into readable form
items.explanation: decrypt /diːˈkrɪpt/ (động từ): giải mã. Trái nghĩa: encrypt (mã hóa). Hash thì không có "decrypt".
items.explanationEn: decrypt /diːˈkrɪpt/ (verb): to turn encrypted data back into readable form. Opposite: encrypt. A hash has no "decrypt".

items.question: Trong câu "Salt: random bytes mixed in before hashing and stored in the hash string itself.", từ "salt" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Salt: random bytes mixed in before hashing and stored in the hash string itself.", what does "salt" (noun) mean?
options: chuỗi ngẫu nhiên trộn vào trước khi băm
items.explanation: salt /sɔːlt/ (danh từ): chuỗi ngẫu nhiên trộn vào trước khi băm. Trong bảo mật, salt không cần giữ bí mật; nó chỉ làm mỗi hash khác nhau. Động từ: to salt a hash.
items.explanationEn: salt /sɔːlt/ (noun): random data added before hashing. In security a salt need not be secret; it just makes every hash unique. Verb: to salt a hash.

items.question: Trong câu "Two users with the same password `secret123` got completely different hashes, so an attacker cannot spot shared passwords or use a precomputed table.", từ "spot" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two users with the same password `secret123` got completely different hashes, so an attacker cannot spot shared passwords or use a precomputed table.", what does "spot" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spot /spɒt/ (động từ): phát hiện, nhận ra. "Spot a bug / a pattern" = phát hiện; danh từ: a spot = một vết/một chỗ.
items.explanationEn: spot /spɒt/ (verb): to notice or see. "Spot a bug / a pattern" means notice it; noun: a spot = a mark or place.

items.question: Trong câu "Two users with the same password `secret123` got completely different hashes, so an attacker cannot spot shared passwords or use a precomputed table.", từ "precomputed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two users with the same password `secret123` got completely different hashes, so an attacker cannot spot shared passwords or use a precomputed table.", what does "precomputed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: precomputed /ˌpriː.kəmˈpjuː.tɪd/ (tính từ): được tính sẵn từ trước. Precomputed table (rainbow table) = bảng hash tính sẵn cho các mật khẩu phổ biến; salt làm nó vô dụng.
items.explanationEn: precomputed /ˌpriː.kəmˈpjuː.tɪd/ (adjective): calculated in advance. A precomputed (rainbow) table maps common passwords to hashes; a salt makes it useless.

items.question: Trong câu "Cost 10: bcrypt is slow on purpose (about 70 ms here).", từ "on purpose" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost 10: bcrypt is slow on purpose (about 70 ms here).", what does "on purpose" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on purpose /ɒn ˈpɜː.pəs/ (cụm từ): cố ý. Trái nghĩa: by accident. Đồng nghĩa: deliberately, intentionally.
items.explanationEn: on purpose /ɒn ˈpɜː.pəs/ (phrase): deliberately. Opposite: by accident. Synonyms: deliberately, intentionally.

items.question: Trong câu "One login does not notice; an attacker trying billions of guesses does.", từ "guess" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One login does not notice; an attacker trying billions of guesses does.", what does "guess" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an attempt to find the right answer without knowing
items.explanation: guess /ɡes/ (danh từ): lần đoán. "Make a guess" = đoán; password guessing = đoán mật khẩu (brute force).
items.explanationEn: guess /ɡes/ (noun): an attempt to find the right answer without knowing. "Make a guess" means try an answer; password guessing is brute force.

items.question: Trong câu "Raising the cost by 1 doubles the work.", từ "double" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Raising the cost by 1 doubles the work.", what does "double" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (động từ): làm tăng gấp đôi. "Double the work/price" = tăng gấp đôi; đối lập: halve.
items.explanationEn: double /ˈdʌb.əl/ (verb): to make twice as big. "Double the work/price" means make it twice as much; opposite: halve.

items.question: Trong câu "The sample stores only a bcrypt hash in `users.password_hash`.", từ "hash" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sample stores only a bcrypt hash in `users.password_hash`.", what does "hash" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the fixed output of a one-way function
items.explanation: hash /hæʃ/ (danh từ): chuỗi băm. Hash (n) = kết quả băm; to hash (v) = băm. Nghĩa khác: món hash, dấu # (hash sign).
items.explanationEn: hash /hæʃ/ (noun): the fixed output of a one-way function. Hash (n) is the output; to hash (v) is to compute it. Other senses: a food dish, the # sign.

items.question: Trong câu "Log in, and the deliberately vague error", từ "vague" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log in, and the deliberately vague error", what does "vague" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vague /veɪɡ/ (tính từ): mơ hồ, không cụ thể. "A vague answer/requirement" = câu trả lời/yêu cầu mơ hồ; BA thường phải làm rõ yêu cầu vague.
items.explanationEn: vague /veɪɡ/ (adjective): not clear or detailed. "A vague answer/requirement" lacks detail; BAs often have to clarify vague requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "That is called account enumeration, and it matters for dating, health or HR apps where merely having an account is private.", từ "enumeration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is called account enumeration, and it matters for dating, health or HR apps where merely having an account is private.", what does "enumeration" (noun) mean?
options: việc dò, liệt kê từng cái
items.explanation: enumeration /ɪˌnjuː.məˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): việc dò, liệt kê từng cái. Account enumeration = dò xem email nào có tài khoản; động từ: enumerate.
items.explanationEn: enumeration /ɪˌnjuː.məˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): listing things one by one. Account enumeration means discovering which emails have accounts; verb: enumerate.

items.question: Trong câu "That is called account enumeration, and it matters for dating, health or HR apps where merely having an account is private.", từ "merely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is called account enumeration, and it matters for dating, health or HR apps where merely having an account is private.", what does "merely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (trạng từ): chỉ, đơn thuần. "Merely having an account" = chỉ riêng việc có tài khoản; đồng nghĩa: simply, just.
items.explanationEn: merely /ˈmɪə.li/ (adverb): only, simply. "Merely having an account" means just having one; synonyms: simply, just.

items.question: Trong câu "Two honest caveats a good tester spots:", từ "caveat" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two honest caveats a good tester spots:", what does "caveat" (noun) mean?
options: lưu ý, điểm cần cảnh báo
items.explanation: caveat /ˈkæv.i.æt/ (danh từ): lưu ý, điểm cần cảnh báo. "One caveat is that…" = có một lưu ý là…; hay gặp trong tài liệu kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: caveat /ˈkæv.i.æt/ (noun): a warning or limitation. "One caveat is that…" introduces a limitation; common in technical docs.

items.question: Trong câu "A patient attacker can measure that; production code compares against a dummy hash so both take the same time.", từ "patient" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A patient attacker can measure that; production code compares against a dummy hash so both take the same time.", what does "patient" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: patient /ˈpeɪ.ʃənt/ (tính từ): kiên nhẫn. Tính từ: kiên nhẫn; danh từ: a patient = bệnh nhân.
items.explanationEn: patient /ˈpeɪ.ʃənt/ (adjective): able to wait calmly. Adjective: calm and willing to wait; noun: a patient = a sick person.

items.question: Trong câu "A patient attacker can measure that; production code compares against a dummy hash so both take the same time.", từ "dummy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A patient attacker can measure that; production code compares against a dummy hash so both take the same time.", what does "dummy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dummy /ˈdʌm.i/ (tính từ): giả, dùng để thế chỗ. Dummy data = dữ liệu giả để test; nghĩa khác (thân mật): người ngốc.
items.explanationEn: dummy /ˈdʌm.i/ (adjective): fake, used as a stand-in. Dummy data is fake test data; informally a "dummy" is a silly person.

items.question: Trong câu "Specify error messages in the acceptance criteria, word for word, and state which facts must never leak.", từ "specify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Specify error messages in the acceptance criteria, word for word, and state which facts must never leak.", what does "specify" (verb) mean?
options: nêu rõ, quy định cụ thể
items.explanation: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): nêu rõ, quy định cụ thể. Danh từ: specification (spec). "Specify the behaviour" = mô tả chính xác hành vi.
items.explanationEn: specify /ˈspes.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to state exactly. Noun: specification (spec). "Specify the behaviour" means describe it exactly.

items.question: Trong câu "Specify error messages in the acceptance criteria, word for word, and state which facts must never leak.", từ "word for word" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Specify error messages in the acceptance criteria, word for word, and state which facts must never leak.", what does "word for word" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: word for word /wɜːd fə wɜːd/ (cụm từ): đúng từng chữ. Đồng nghĩa: verbatim. Dùng khi thông báo lỗi phải khớp chính xác để QA kiểm tra.
items.explanationEn: word for word /wɜːd fə wɜːd/ (phrase): using exactly the same words. Synonym: verbatim. Used when error messages must match exactly for QA.

items.question: Trong câu "The payload is only encoded, not encrypted.", từ "payload" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The payload is only encoded, not encrypted.", what does "payload" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the main data carried by a message
items.explanation: payload /ˈpeɪ.ləʊd/ (danh từ): phần dữ liệu chính (của token/request). Trong IT: payload của JWT/request = phần dữ liệu. Nghĩa gốc: tải trọng hàng hóa.
items.explanationEn: payload /ˈpeɪ.ləʊd/ (noun): the main data carried by a message. In IT, the payload of a JWT/request is its data. Original sense: cargo.

items.question: Trong câu "The payload is only encoded, not encrypted.", từ "encode" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The payload is only encoded, not encrypted.", what does "encode" (verb) mean?
options: mã hóa bảo mật bằng khóa
mã hóa định dạng (ai cũng giải được)
optionsEn: to convert into another format anyone can reverse
items.explanation: encode /ɪnˈkəʊd/ (động từ): mã hóa định dạng (ai cũng giải được). Encode (base64) không cần khóa, ai cũng decode được; khác với encrypt.
items.explanationEn: encode /ɪnˈkəʊd/ (verb): to convert into another format anyone can reverse. Encoding (base64) needs no key and anyone can decode it; unlike encrypting.

items.question: Trong câu "It cannot be forged without `JWT_SECRET`.", từ "forge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It cannot be forged without `JWT_SECRET`.", what does "forge" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make a fake copy to deceive
items.explanation: forge /fɔːdʒ/ (động từ): làm giả. "Forge a token/signature" = làm giả; danh từ: forgery. Nghĩa gốc: rèn (thợ rèn).
items.explanationEn: forge /fɔːdʒ/ (verb): to make a fake copy to deceive. "Forge a token/signature" means fake it; noun: forgery. Original sense: to shape metal.

items.question: Trong câu "Change one character and the signature no longer matches.", từ "signature" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Change one character and the signature no longer matches.", what does "signature" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a code proving data is genuine
items.explanation: signature /ˈsɪɡ.nə.tʃə/ (danh từ): chữ ký (số). Digital signature = chữ ký số, tính từ dữ liệu + khóa bí mật; sửa dữ liệu là chữ ký sai.

items.explanation: readable /ˈriː.də.bəl/ (tính từ): đọc được. Human-readable = con người đọc được; nghĩa khác: a readable novel = cuốn sách dễ đọc.
items.explanationEn: readable /ˈriː.də.bəl/ (adjective): able to be read. Human-readable means people can read it; another sense: a readable (enjoyable) novel.

items.question: Trong câu "Say which attack each cookie attribute blocks, and why tokens do not belong in localStorage.", từ "attribute" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Say which attack each cookie attribute blocks, and why tokens do not belong in localStorage.", what does "attribute" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: attribute /ˈæt.rɪ.bjuːt/ (danh từ): thuộc tính. Cookie/HTML attribute = thuộc tính; động từ /əˈtrɪb.juːt/: attribute X to Y = quy X cho Y.
items.explanationEn: attribute /ˈæt.rɪ.bjuːt/ (noun): a property or setting. A cookie/HTML attribute is a property; verb /əˈtrɪb.juːt/: attribute X to Y = credit X to Y.

items.question: Trong câu "Say which attack each cookie attribute blocks, and why tokens do not belong in localStorage.", từ "belong" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Say which attack each cookie attribute blocks, and why tokens do not belong in localStorage.", what does "belong" (verb) mean?
options: thuộc về chỗ đúng, nên nằm ở
optionsEn: to be in the right place
items.explanation: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (động từ): thuộc về chỗ đúng, nên nằm ở. "X belongs in Y" = X nên nằm ở Y; "belong to" = thuộc về ai đó.
items.explanationEn: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (verb): to be in the right place. "X belongs in Y" means Y is the right place; "belong to" means be owned by.

items.question: Trong câu "The three DevTools topics build on everything you made, including this login, so keep your test account handy.", từ "build on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The three DevTools topics build on everything you made, including this login, so keep your test account handy.", what does "build on" (phrase) mean?
options: dựa trên, phát triển tiếp từ
optionsEn: to use as a base for more
items.explanation: build on /bɪld ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa trên, phát triển tiếp từ. "Build on previous work" = phát triển tiếp dựa trên cái đã có.
items.explanationEn: build on /bɪld ɒn/ (phrase): to use as a base for more. "Build on previous work" means extend what already exists.

items.question: Trong câu "The three DevTools topics build on everything you made, including this login, so keep your test account handy.", từ "handy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The three DevTools topics build on everything you made, including this login, so keep your test account handy.", what does "handy" (adjective) mean?
options: ở sẵn, dễ lấy khi cần
optionsEn: close by and ready to use
items.explanation: handy /ˈhæn.di/ (tính từ): ở sẵn, dễ lấy khi cần. "Keep X handy" = để X sẵn trong tầm tay; nghĩa khác: khéo tay (handy with tools).
items.explanationEn: handy /ˈhæn.di/ (adjective): close by and ready to use. "Keep X handy" means keep it within reach; another sense: skilful (handy with tools).
